A corporate website is increasingly ill-served by the word "showcase". If the comparison is being performed by an AI agent, what matters is not the impression but verifiability: what can be structurally read, compared, and confirmed. Hence the thesis: the website is becoming not a facade, but a verifiable representation of the business. An interesting question is where, for you, the boundary lies between a machine-readable fact and a claim that already requires a separate layer of trust. #webarchitecture #seo #ai
